Redistribution
--------------
Bundled with the permission of the author (confirmed by the project owner,
who asked him directly). loopMIDI is proprietary freeware, not open source;
this package only redistributes the unmodified vendor installer so that the
adapter can be deployed on a machine with no network access.

The installer is the vendor's own. Nothing here modifies it, wraps it, or
changes its licensing behaviour. Installing it is the same action as running
the download by hand, and it is only attempted when loopMIDI is absent.
